title: Paper Payment Handling Charge on Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Charge.** Under the paper-payment handling schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a late fee on a Pre-K tuition account carries a handling charge set by the number of tuition payments the enrollment shows by personal check or money order in the school year:

| Tuition payments on the enrollment by personal check or money order in the school year | Handling charge carried by the late fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | 15.00 |
| exactly one | 10.00 |
| none | nothing |

Payments by personal check and by money order are counted together. Payments by online card or ACH bank draft are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

| Payments recorded this school year | Count | Handling charge |
|---|---|---|
| one money order, three online card payments | 1 | 10.00 |
| one personal check and one money order | 2 | 15.00 |
| four ACH bank draft payments | 0 | nothing |
